title: Compose Companion proposal decision in the PWA

gates.name: companion_decision_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companion-decision.spec.ts

verify: Independent decision verification covers exact approve/reject, duplicate, superseded/version/role/archive failures, authoritative DecisionRecord/effect reread, and Safety-authority absence.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-031 RED: no browser current-proposal decision consumer exists; GREEN: exact authorized approve/reject returns the backend DecisionRecord/effect while duplicate, superseded, version, role, and archive paths fail safely and no response grants Safety authority; decisive comparison: strict request, response/DOM, and authoritative proposal/DecisionRecord/Task reread; artifact: decision evidence under .tasks/TASK-108-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose current-proposal decision independently of Companion reads, invocation, and issue close.
success_outcome: Authorized Boss/Engineer users can decide only the current versioned proposal while superseded/denied/archive paths leave governance state unchanged and Safety authority remains absent.
anti_goals: Do not implement reads, invoke Companion, close/reopen issues, replace proposal effect/text, or approve a superseded proposal.
Do not treat governance approval as Safety approval or create action_task/device authority.

forbidden_scope: caller-selected proposal effect or Task text
stop_conditions: Decision needs a field or command outside Companion Governance HTTP.
The PWA would need to replace an effect or equate governance with Safety approval.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Companion Governance owns proposal, DecisionRecord, effect, and Task transaction.
Submit only the exact versioned decision body and render authoritative results.
invariants: DecisionRecord never grants Safety authority or creates action_task by itself.
Superseded, denied, stale, or archived proposal state cannot advance.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-031: exact approve/reject/duplicate plus superseded/version/role/archive failure and authoritative effect reread.
T3 harm proof uses isolated proposals and verifies safe rerun/denial causes no unauthorized Task, Plant, or Safety effect.
